### 1. Executive Context & Baseline

<!-- What emergent behavior, friction point, or breakthrough was observed? Include metrics, transcript snippets, or quotes. -->

### 3. The Underlying Failure Mode or Catalyst
<!-- Why did this happen? Analyze cognitive or architectural causes. -->

### 4. Remediation & Architectural Pattern
<!-- What architectural pattern or invariant gate was deployed to resolve it? -->

### 5. Verifiable Impact & Key Takeaways
<!-- Evidence of the result: test runs, gate output, or measured figures, each with the command that produced it. -->

### Sanitization Verification
- [ ] No private IP addresses or internal hostnames (only RFC 5737 and `example.com` used).
- [ ] No plaintext secrets, tokens, or credentials.
- [ ] Abstract paths used (`/home/user/...`).
